Moltres

Fire Flying

Kanto · Generation 1 · Legendary Pokémon

Moltres is a Fire/Flying-type Flame Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 2 m tall and weighs 60 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (125), with a base stat total of 580.
